scope: Independent CPU calculation from retained measurement CSV and per-anchor/per-pass records; no production-summary function import; same-team audit, not independent native rerun.
fallacy_scan: Dataset results remain separate; no pooled cross-dataset efficacy conclusion.
Per-request wins and regressions are retained; aggregate gains are not attributed to every request.
Input-only deterministic selection avoids output-based filtering, but panels are reused development data, not a fresh population sample.
No outcome-conditioned covariates or subgroup selection; all requested valid completions retained.
256-request denominators, gross saved/added calls and all ties are explicit; this is not a screening accuracy analysis.
Fixed inputs and contemporaneous controls, without selection for extreme prior outcomes; early-to-late latency is not used as a learning curve.
All six trajectories, both endpoints and all 4,608 evaluation rows complete; no unfavorable rows omitted.
Two primary dataset-specific endpoint contrasts and secondary contrasts/metrics are all shown. Intervals are unadjusted; no familywise confirmation claim.
Fixed code/panels/arms/events/bootstrap before outcomes; no best-intermediate selection or post-result tuning.
Controlled online recipes differ in own generated feedback and resulting features. Local diagnostics do not isolate a loss mechanism or prove why native calls changed.
Training precedes serving; diagnostic/evaluation feedback never trains a model. Direction in this bounded experiment is temporally fixed.
numerical_comparison: Float reaggregation tolerance abs1e-10/rel1e-12 only, not a changed experimental qualification tolerance.
